1  The Police-Inspector of Basavanagudi Women South P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 and 2 for the offences punishable U/s.498A, 506 of IPC. & Sec.3, 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Swathi.S.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused No.1 got married to CW-1 on 29-04-2021.
While residing together Accused No.1 took 250 gms of gold jewels and cash of Rs. One lakh from CW-1.
After the marriage, CW-1 while residing with Accused No.1, the Accused No.1 demanded and harassed CW-1 for further dowry and gold jewels from the parents of CW-1.

After the marriage, while CW-1 started residing with Accused No.1 at No.17/1, 1st floor, Basavanagudi Tata silk farm, 4th main along with her two children born out of wedlock of deceased first husband of CW-1.
While residing, Accused No.1 used to  3  C.C.No.30669/2022 harass CW-1 in demand of gold jewels and cash and teased her.
Accused No.2 took daughter of CW-1 Brahmini in adoption and Accused were not allowing to visit her daughter.
When CW-1 refused to bring additional dowry and gold jewels.

Accused subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty and asked her to leave the matrimonial home, if she fails to bring money and gold ornaments from her parents house and criminally intimidated to do away with her life and thus subjected CW-1 to cruelty both physically and mentally in demand of additional dowry.

9. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  10.
The witnesses cited in the charge sheet did not appeared and lead their evidence and there are no materials against accused as Cws. 1 to 7 were not secured by the prosecution, they were dropped.
This court issued summons, warrant and proclamation to Cws.1 to 7.
But the concerned police could not secure the presence of the witnesses in-spite of issuance of several times process by this court.
It is learn that Cws.1 to 7 may not be secured in near future days.
Hence, prayer of Sr.APP to reissue witness summons to Cw's was rejected and CW-1 to 7 were dropped and prosecution side evidence is taken as Nil.
Since there was no incriminating evidence against the accused, the statement of accused U/s.313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
